title: From a City Apartment to a Rural One-Room Cottage
en: people often ask me for guidance on how to make the transition from their lifestyle to the countryside i cannot give any advice that applies to everyone and so i'm reticent to give any at all you know your own situation best and i will leave resources down below that may be useful to you however i want to offer you a perspective that may be helpful in a different way i hope it can bring comfort to you as you try to change your life or encourage you to embrace your current situation making a move to a rural area isn't feasible or practical for everyone for example i was lucky to be

able-bodied and young and find a job within my skill set that gives me a livable wage those can be hard to come by for millennials like myself however you can bring so much of what you love about another way of life into your own reality without making the physical move and it is just as rich and meaningful think about where you live maybe it's a cozy city apartment a town or the countryside wherever you are imagine that that is exactly where you need to be at this point in your personal story stories don't begin at the end

they present the hero's journey from one place to another physically or internally this is something that has truly helped me on my path to change my life comforted me when i felt stuck but to also see the worth in the process of taking months years or decades to get to where i want to go at 19 i was a student living in a condemnable infested apartment right next to a highway i deeply disliked where i lived and i would cry myself to sleep some nights because adult life was nothing like i imagined it to be i was lonely and tired of being a student staying awake all night studying

only to have to go to my job as a magazine editor the next day my dreams of a quiet peaceful life in the countryside seemed completely out of reach i was burned out and unhealthy in both mind and body if you've ever been there you know that one of the most dangerous parts of feeling that way is that you think it will last forever and believe tomorrow will be no different and for a time i did give in and i despaired and then one day i decided that my despair was a lie and asked for help ever so slowly things got better and i started to feel again

so those were hard years but looking back it clarified what i wanted out of life what i needed and what i had to change in my mentality in order to succeed was it a happy time no but life doesn't need to always be happy in order to be fruitful i had to look within and examine the source of my feelings living in the future was ruining my present i started taking practical steps towards the life i wanted saving and researching and applying to jobs

i had to work hard for years to make my dreams come true but the hardest part was learning to be satisfied where i currently was i needed to know that i could build a wonderful life whether or not things were perfect only then would i be ready to make the move successfully and to be happy many of us will experience living in at

least a couple different places in our lives maybe you love where you live maybe you want to live somewhere else whatever your situation is i encourage you to embrace your current location and pour your love into living your best life if that seems hard find little ways to appreciate your place in the steps you take in order to plan for the future for example if you love your home in the city but miss nature you can adopt plants and make it a space full of life no matter where you are you can live more sustainably and in alignment with the seasons instead of wishing to fulfill a future dream try to live a version of it in the meantime imperfect yes but that's how life is it challenges us to simply enjoy existing

i have lived in the city the countryside and in between each place has benefits and suits different personalities and can lead to a wonderful story i like to think that with the right mindset you can cultivate contentment in most places assuming that your basic needs are met of course you may not be in your ideal location maybe it's a stepping stone that will offer you many opportunities to learn and grow in the process either way your thoughts and insights are always appreciated and helpful to all of us feel free to comment your experience down below i wish you all the best in trying to change improve or simply love your life and location even more take care okay
zh: 人们经常向我寻求如何从他们的生活方式过渡到农村的指导，我无法提供任何适用于每个人的建议，因此我不愿提供任何建议，您最了解自己的情况，我会将可能对您有用的资源留在下面，但我想为您提供一个可能以不同方式有所帮助的观点，我希望它可以在您尝试改变生活时给您带来安慰，或鼓励您接受当前的状况，搬到农村地区对每个人来说都是不可行或不切实际的，例如我是幸运的是
身体健康，年轻，在我的技能范围内找到一份工作，给我一份可以维持生计的工作，这对于像我这样的千禧一代来说很难获得，但是你可以将你热爱的另一种生活方式带入你自己的现实，而无需进行身体搬迁，这同样丰富和有意义想想你住在哪里，也许是一个舒适的城市公寓，一个城镇或乡村，无论你在哪里，想象一下，这正是你需要在的地方，在你的个人故事的这一点上，故事不是从最后开始的
他们呈现了英雄从一个地方到另一个地方的物理或内心旅程，这确实帮助我走上了改变生活的道路，当我感到陷入困境时安慰了我，但也看到了花费数月、数年或数十年才能到达我想去的地方的价值。 19岁时，我是一名学生，住在高速公路旁边一套应受谴责的虫害公寓里，我非常不喜欢我住的地方，有些晚上我会哭着入睡，因为成年生活并不像我想象的那样，我感到孤独和疲惫作为一个彻夜不眠学习的学生
第二天我就得去当杂志编辑了，我在乡村过上平静生活的梦想似乎完全遥不可及，我精疲力尽，身心都不健康，如果你曾经去过那里，你知道，这种感觉最危险的部分之一就是你认为这种感觉会永远持续下去，相信明天不会有什么不同，有一段时间我确实屈服了，我绝望了，然后有一天，我决定我的绝望是一个谎言，并寻求帮助，事情慢慢地好起来，我开始了再次感受
所以那些年很艰难，但回想起来，它澄清了我想要从生活中得到什么，我需要什么，我必须改变心态才能成功，这是一个快乐的时光吗？不，但生活并不需要总是快乐才能富有成效，我必须审视自己，检查我的感受的根源，生活在未来正在毁掉我的现在，我开始采取实际步骤，实现我想要储蓄的生活，研究并申请工作
我必须努力工作多年才能实现我的梦想，但最困难的部分是学会对我目前的处境感到满意，我需要知道我可以建立美好的生活，无论事情是否完美，只有这样我才能准备好成功搬家，并为我们中的许多人居住而感到高兴。

我们生活中至少有几个不同的地方 也许你喜欢你居住的地方 也许你想住在其他地方 无论你的情况如何 我鼓励你拥抱你当前的位置，并倾注你的爱过上最好的生活，如果这看起来很难，找到一些方法来欣赏你在你所采取的步骤中的位置，以便规划未来，例如，如果你喜欢你在城市的家，但想念大自然，你可以采用植物，让它成为一个充满生机的空间，无论你身在何处，你都可以更可持续地生活，与季节保持一致，而不是希望实现未来的梦想尝试同时活出它的一个版本 不完美 是的，但这就是生活，它挑战我们简单地享受现有的

我住在城市乡村，每个地方都有好处，适合不同的个性，可以带来一个精彩的故事我喜欢认为，只要有正确的心态，你就可以在大多数地方培养满足感，假设你的基本需求得到满足，当然你可能不在你理想的位置，也许这是一块垫脚石，将为你提供许多学习和成长的机会，无论哪种方式，你的想法和见解总是受到赞赏，对我们所有人都有帮助，请随时在下面评论你的经历，我希望你在努力改变和改进的过程中一切顺利或者只是更加热爱你的生活和地点，保重好吗
